# FA · Flight aerodynamics & physics (FA)

<!-- generated by tools/build.py from curriculum/syllabus.yaml — do not edit -->

The physics a flying machine needs, from zero: vectors and forces, Newton's laws in flight, work, energy and power, and the wind, trajectory and unit maths that the flight lessons assume.
